meta.note: 「今日一句」唯一数据源。台词墙 / today 页 / Scriptable 小组件共用。按日期取 index：floor((今天UTC-startUTC)/天) 对 count 取模。改这里三处同步。

lines.name: Gary
lines.label: OFF THE CLOCK
lines.line: I'd rather lose clean than win dirty.
lines.lineCN: 宁可干干净净地输，也不脏着赢。

lines.name: Krzysztof "Kris" Wilk
lines.label: PO POLSKU
lines.line: Ja też cię chcę.
lines.lineCN: 我也想要你。

lines.name: Matty
lines.label: THE NEXT ONE
lines.line: I always thought the next one'd be better — I never thought she'd stay.
lines.lineCN: 我一直以为「下一个」会更好——没想到她真的留了下来。

lines.name: Buck "The Kid"
lines.label: HIS FAVORITE THING
lines.line: Here. This one's my favorite. It's yours now.
lines.lineCN: 给你。这个我最喜欢——现在归你了。

lines.name: Trent
lines.label: ON THE ROAD OUT
lines.line: I was saving up to leave. Now I'm saving up to take you with me.
lines.lineCN: 我攒钱本是为了离开——如今攒钱，是为了带你一起走。

lines.name: Samuel
lines.label: COULDN'T PICK A LOCK
lines.line: Can't crack a single safe. Cracked you wide open, though.
lines.lineCN: 一个保险箱都撬不开——倒是把你，轻轻松松撬开了。

lines.name: Jerry
lines.label: OFF THE LIST
lines.line: You were supposed to be a job. You're the one thing I never finished.
lines.lineCN: 你本该只是一单活——却成了我唯一没下手完成的事。

lines.name: Wild Bill Wharton
lines.label: UNDER HIS BREATH
lines.line: I ain't listenin' to you.
lines.lineCN: 我才没听你的。

lines.name: Guy Fleegman
lines.label: CREWMAN HALE
lines.line: Hale. So I make it to the end after all.
lines.lineCN: Hale——原来我能活到结局。

lines.name: Eric Knox
lines.label: EVERY MOVE BUT ONE
lines.line: I planned every move on the board. I never planned on you.
lines.lineCN: 棋盘上每一步我都算到了——唯独没算到你。

lines.name: Pero "Pepe" Mahalovic
lines.label: BEFORE THE BELL
lines.line: Up on the canvas I yell "I'm too good-lookin'". You're the only one who actually agrees.
lines.lineCN: 拳台上我喊「我太好看了」——也只有你，会真的点头，还夸我一句好看。

lines.name: Chuck Barris
lines.label: OFF THE AIR
lines.line: I've conned a whole country. You're the only one I never want to fool.
lines.lineCN: 我骗过整个国家——你是我唯一不想骗的人。

lines.name: Frank Mercer
lines.label: THE PART HE COULDN'T PLAY
lines.line: I've played every part there is. Yours is the one I couldn't keep up.
lines.lineCN: 什么角色我都演过——唯独你那一场，我演不下去了。

lines.name: Jim Crocker
lines.label: THE ONE THAT'S REAL
lines.line: I'll be anyone you like — but the fool in love? That one's actually me.
lines.lineCN: 你要谁我就演谁——可那个爱上你的傻瓜，才是真的我。

lines.name: Zaphod Beeblebrox
lines.film: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
lines.label: BOTH HEADS AGREE
lines.line: My two heads agree on exactly one thing, baby doll. You.
lines.lineCN: 我那两个脑袋只在一件事上意见一致，baby doll——就是你。

lines.name: Brad Cairn
lines.label: THE FIRST TO ASK
lines.line: You were the first to ask if I was okay. I'd forgotten that was a question.
lines.lineCN: 你是第一个问我「还好吗」的人——我都快忘了，这也能是个问题。

lines.name: Glenn Marchand
lines.label: THE ONE WHO DIDN'T BURN
lines.line: I'm the fire that burns everything down. You're the one who didn't.
lines.lineCN: 我是那团烧尽一切的火——你是唯一，没被烧毁的人。

lines.name: Jim Reston
lines.label: OFF THE RECORD
lines.line: I won't say "I love you" — too cheap. I'll just prove they were wrong about you.
lines.lineCN: 我不说「我爱你」——太廉价。我只会逐条证明：他们看错了你。

lines.name: Victor Mancini
lines.label: BEFORE HE COULD ASK
lines.line: Everyone left before I could ask them to stay. You stayed before I dared.
lines.lineCN: 所有人都在我开口挽留之前就走了——你却在我还不敢开口之前，留下了。

lines.name: Sam Bell
lines.label: SARANG
lines.line: Every one of us was built to die a tool. You woke us up as a family.
lines.lineCN: 我们本该作为工具一个个死去——是你，把我们当成一家人唤醒。

lines.name: Robert Goode
lines.label: THE PAPER HAT
lines.line: I'm keeping the silly hat on. You're the one who put it there.
lines.lineCN: 这顶歪歪的傻帽子我不摘——是你给我戴上的。

lines.name: Justin Hammer
lines.label: OFF THE STAGE
lines.line: I don't have to be him — not when you look at me like that.
lines.lineCN: 我不必活成他——只要你这样看着我。

lines.name: Kenny Waters
lines.label: NEVER TO YOU
lines.line: I'll lie to a judge, a jury, the whole damn town — never to you.
lines.lineCN: 法官、陪审团、整个镇子我都能骗——唯独不骗你。

lines.name: Billy Bickle
lines.label: REWROTE THE ENDING
lines.line: I wanted to go out in a blaze. You rewrote the ending — so I lived. For you and you only.
lines.lineCN: 我本想轰轰烈烈地谢幕——是你改了结局，于是我活了下来。只为你。

lines.name: Owen
lines.label: A CRIME AT THE WATER PARK
lines.line: Being sad at a water park's a crime. C'mon — I'm breaking you out.
lines.lineCN: 在水上乐园还愁眉苦脸，这可是犯罪——走，我带你越狱。

lines.name: John Moon
lines.label: STILL BREATHING
lines.line: I'd already climbed into the grave. You're the one who heard me breathing.
lines.lineCN: 我已经躺进了那个坑里——是你，听见了我还在呼吸。

lines.name: Doug Varney
lines.label: OFF THE LEASH
lines.line: Spent my whole life behind that counter. You made me feel alive.
lines.lineCN: 我这辈子都困在柜台后面——是你，让我觉得自己还活着。

lines.name: Wayne
lines.label: MEANT IT ALL ALONG
lines.line: I called it a joke so it wouldn't hurt when you said no. You said yes.
lines.lineCN: 我假装是玩笑，这样你拒绝时我才不会疼——可你说了「我愿意」。

lines.name: Craig
lines.label: WHY PEOPLE START
lines.line: I end marriages for a living. With you, I remembered why people start them.
lines.lineCN: 我靠终结婚姻为生——和你在一起，我才想起人们为什么开始。

lines.name: Francis Munch
lines.label: AND HE NEVER LIES
lines.line: I never lie. So believe this one: I'd kill for you.
lines.lineCN: 我从不说假话——所以这句你要信：我会为你杀人。

lines.name: Jason Dixon
lines.label: TRYIN' EVERY DAY
lines.line: I'm no good at this. But I'm tryin' — every damn day — to be who you saw.
lines.lineCN: 我不擅长这个。可我每天都在拼命，想成为你看见的那个我。

lines.name: Eddie
lines.label: PLAYING IT OUT
lines.line: Never been dealt a good hand. But this one I'll play with you till the end.
lines.lineCN: 我这辈子没拿过一手好牌——可这一手，我要和你打到底。

lines.name: George W. Bush
lines.label: JUST A COWBOY
lines.line: Everybody's watchin' the most powerful man in the world. You're just watchin' some cowboy from Texas.
lines.lineCN: 全世界都盯着那个「最有权力的人」——你盯着的，不过是个德州来的牛仔。

lines.name: Captain Klenzendorf
lines.label: NEVER OUT LOUD
lines.line: I'll never say it out loud. I'll just spend everything I have keeping you safe.
lines.lineCN: 这话我永远不会说出口——我只会用我所有的一切，换你平安。

lines.name: Watson Bryant
lines.label: SO HE STAYED
lines.line: Everyone else packed up and left. I know who you are — so I stayed.
lines.lineCN: 别人都收拾东西走了。我知道你是什么人——所以我没走。

lines.name: Mr. Wolf
lines.label: RATHER EARN IT
lines.line: I could steal anything in the world. You're the first thing I'd rather earn.
lines.lineCN: 这世上没有我偷不到的东西——你却是第一件，我宁愿靠自己挣来的。

lines.name: Inspector Stoppard
lines.label: CHOSE ME ANYWAY
lines.line: Nobody ever stayed for me. You saw all of it — and chose me anyway.
lines.lineCN: 从来没人为我留下来。你看清了这一切——还是选了我。

lines.name: Aidan Wilde
lines.label: ALREADY THERE
lines.line: When it all goes up in flames, kid — you won't have to look for me. I'm already there.
lines.lineCN: 当一切都烧起来时，kid——你不必回头找我，我早就在了。

lines.name: The Man from the Future
lines.film: Good Luck, Have Fun, Don't Die
lines.label: ATTEMPT ONE-EIGHTEEN
lines.line: A hundred and seventeen times I tried to save the world. This time I just want to stay.
lines.lineCN: 一百一十七次，我都在试着拯救世界——这一次，我只想留在你身边。

lines.name: Claiborne "C.P." "Clay" Ellis
lines.label: SIXTEEN YEARS TOO LATE
lines.line: Don't go, Winter. This time — please don't go.
lines.lineCN: 别走，Winter。这一次，求你了，别走。
